nom: CeraVe Hydrating Mineral Sunscreen Face Lotion with Sheer Tint SPF 30

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or seborrheic psoriasis, mostly report it protects without irritation, but one reviewer with sensitive, rosacea-prone skin reports her skin was red and irritated by the end of the day.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed results: some describe it as greasy and breakout-triggering, while one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin and large pores calls it a holy grail.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry-to-normal skin report a dewy, non-greasy finish with meaningful hydration.

concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report mixed experiences with oiliness: several describe the lotion as greasy or leaving the T-zone very oily through the day, while others, including one with oily skin, report it wears oil-free.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts, but one reviewer says her skin broke out after a week of use, while a reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports it did not trigger breakouts for her.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the sunscreen damaged her skin barrier over months of use, tracing it to a salicylic acid ingredient and describing scaly, peeling skin that took a long time to resolve.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, rosacea-prone skin reports her face was red and irritated by the end of the day despite finding the shade and hydration level otherwise good.

aspects.libelle: Can oxidize orange or not match the intended shade
Can leave a white or ashy cast on some skin tones
Dispenser is messy without a pump
Combines sunscreen, moisturizer and light coverage in one step
Can pill over serums or other products

extraits.texte: I got this before vacation and noticed that my skin was really sensitive on the trip, but chalked it up to makeup wipes and rollercoasters. By the end of the week, my eyelids were scaly and flaky, and the skin near my mouth was peeling. Tried to repair my barrier and no matter what I did, even LRP cicabalm, my face still stung. For months, I changed my skincare routine, one product at a time. I was at the end of options and saw my sunscreen in the cabinet, which was the last straw. The tube doesnt have the ingredients, so I had to go through my ulta account to find them. No idea why cerave added salicylic acid to the formula, but it's there - and I think its in there twice. So, sensitive faces, beware. Disappointed for sure, and out tons of money trying to fix the barrier I was slowly damaging over and over again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is more of a full coverage foundation than a sunscreen. It was super greasy and would get worse throughout the day. My skin broke out from using this product for a week. I wanted to love it as it was a great foundation/sunscreen but it was just way too greasy!

I really thought i had found a great daily wear sunscreen option until my skin started to become irritated. It's on the moisturizing side. The light shade worked well for my light cool skin tone. Unfortunately by the end of the day my skin was red and irritated. I do have very sensitive skin with rosacea.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture to this sunscreen is pretty oily I noticed my t zone was getting extremely oily when using this. I can also feel the later on my face throughout my day which really frustrated me. It didn't break me out though so that's a plus but it also didn't cover any of my existing breakouts.

extraits.titre: Mineral protection without the white cast!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed this mineral sunscreen! I tried the shade light. Most importantly, I did not get a sunburn while wearing it at any point. In my opinion, if you are looking for a product to offer sunscreen and meaningful coverage, this is not for you - I found the tint prevented any white cast and had a smoothing effect on my skin, but you could still fully see my coloring coming through underneath. (I have freckles, and they are totally visible, which I was happy for!) I think this is a positive, because it leads me to believe each shade would work for a wider range of skin tones without having to be worried too much about the color match. However, if you have very rosy skin, the undertones of the light shade might be too yellow - I, however, have yellow undertones and was grateful it was not overly cool toned. I have dry-to-normal skin, and the finish is dewy without being greasy. The packaging makes it easy to dispense and a little goes a long way. It seems to be lasting me a long time, making it a good value for the price! Overall, I could definitely see myself repurchasing this product in the future for effortless protection with a little glow.

extraits.titre: Works great with my skin type
extraits.texte: I have seborrheic psoriasis, and it's always been important to me to protect my skin with SPF. However, too many of them made my skin so oily. This mineral sunscreen has worked the best at keeping my sensitive skin protected and oil-free.
This product is my holy grail. I have oily, acne prone, and large pores and this is absolutely stunning on me. I wish it lasted longer but I just reapply every 2 hours and it looks flawless.
